messages:
maria: Quick a11y pass on the top toolbar—noticed two issues: low contrast on the inactive icons and the focus ring disappears when tabbing between grouped controls.

 tom: Can you attach a screenshot or repro steps?

 maria: Screenshot: https://example.com/toolbar-contrast.png
 Repro: 1) Open console 2) Tab through header toolbar 3) See focus flicker on second icon

 olivia: Thanks—saw this in Lighthouse too. Contrast for icon fill is 2.8:1 on dark mode; target is >=4.5:1 for text/icons. Also the focus outline is set on :hover but removed on :focus-within in the group—bad.

 sam: Repro locally. Looks like the grouped buttons use .btn-group { outline: none; } from earlier change. I'll try toggling to keep visible focus.

 jess: From product POV can we avoid making icons heavier? We need subtlety, but accessibility > subtle. Maybe increased stroke or an always-on focus ring.

 maria: Suggested CSS we tried:
 ```
 .toolbar .icon { color: var(--muted); }
 .toolbar .icon:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
 ```
 But group wrapping removed focus styles.

 olivia: Also ARIA: the toolbar items are buttons but missing aria-pressed on toggle state. Screen reader (VoiceOver) doesn't announce a change when switching mode.

 a11y-bot: Automated check report:
 - failed: color-contrast (icon 2.8)
 - failed: focus-visible (no persistent focus for grouped controls)
 - warn: aria-pressed missing on toggle buttons

 sam: Plan: 1) restore focus-visible for group children 2) increase icon contrast to 4.5:1 by using --text-strong for fills 3) add aria-pressed and update announcements.

 jess: Owner: sam to implement; olivia to verify; maria to update QA checklist. ETA end of day Thursday.

 olivia: Also recommend adding a polite live-region announcement for context switches: `role="status" aria-live="polite"` when toggling global modes.

 maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: Adding to accessibility board and linking PR once ready.
